decisions.reason: A is a core operator line with proven demand and little remaining uncertainty, so its option value is realized and it is unlikely to be dropped.
B remains a niche solid-wood option that is still cheap to keep and has not shown clearly negative results, so the option is maintained.
C has become redundant with the broader operator line and its standalone option value has largely disappeared, making abandonment likely to free resources.
F is the surviving glazed industrial door option with a dedicated page and continued market promise, so it is kept with a low withdrawal probability.
